columns.name: looseqty

table.retrieve:
SELECT
	item.customicode, 
	srdetail.alternatecustomicode,
	item.name, 
	srdetail.returnitemdescription,  
	currlistrow = 0,
	stock = 0.0000, 
	currstock=srdetail.currstock,
	packingdesc=space(50),
	totalstock=0.0000,
	saleqty = 0.0000, 
	retableqty = 0.0000, 
	retablebonusqty = 0.0000, 
	salebonusqty = 0.0000, 
	dbo.srdetail.srinvcode ,
	dbo.srdetail.gcode , 
	dbo.srdetail.icode , 
	dbo.srdetail.batch , 
	dbo.srdetail.expiry , 
	dbo.srdetail.packqty ,
	dbo.srdetail.unitsalestax,
	dbo.srdetail.gstperc,  
	dbo.srdetail.packunits ,  
	dbo.srdetail.srprice ,
	dbo.srdetail.srutn ,
	dbo.srdetail.saleprice,
	dbo.srdetail.avgprice ,
	dbo.srdetail.newavgprice,
	dbo.srdetail.salestax ,
	dbo.srdetail.discperc ,
	dbo.srdetail.claimable,
	dbo.srdetail.claimablediscperc ,
	dbo.srdetail.TotalPieces,
	dbo.srdetail.PiecesInHand,
	srdetail.CommissionPerc,
	srdetail.CommissionPerUnit,
	dbo.srdetail.alternatepurprice,
	Taxable = Item.Taxable,
	ItemAdvanceTaxPerc = srdetail.ItemAdvanceTaxPerc,
	bonusqty=dbo.srdetail.bonusqty,
	dbo.srdetail.looseqty
FROM
	srdetail,   
	item 
WHERE 
	( srdetail.icode = item.icode ) and  
	( dbo.srdetail.srinvcode = :ra_salesretinvno )

objects.name: c_detaildwtotal
objects.expression: sum((( srprice   *  packqty )+( srprice   *  looseqty ))* ((100 -  discperc) /100)  for all)
